Building context-aware AI agents just got a massive upgrade. 

Firecrawl gives AI agents the exact context API they need by turning complex, JavaScript-heavy web pages into clean LLM-ready markdown at scale.

If you are building RAG pipelines or autonomous agents, you already know the pain of scraping the modern web. Between brittle headless browser setups, dynamic JS rendering, rotating proxies, bot protections, and rate limits, building a reliable data ingestion pipeline is a massive time sink. 

Firecrawl offloads all of that heavy lifting so you can focus on building your app. 

Key features developers love:
• LLM-ready outputs that convert messy websites, PDFs, and docs into clean markdown or structured JSON to minimize token consumption
• Interactive browser automation that lets you scrape a page and use prompts or code to click, scroll, and navigate dynamically
• Autonomous agent endpoints that search, navigate, and retrieve data across the web without requiring upfront URL specs
• Seamless integration with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and custom CLI skills for instant real-time web queries

Whether you are powering real-time RAG systems with up-to-date documentation or enabling AI agents to extract structured business data on demand, Firecrawl delivers a production-ready API via Python, Node.js, CLI, or MCP.

Check out the repo, drop a star, and stop fighting with custom scrapers:
https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl

🚀 Want up to 2.6x higher AI tensor performance on your consumer GeForce GPU without buying enterprise hardware?

For AI engineers, ML researchers, and local LLM operators, artificial limitations on Tensor core calculations have always been a bottleneck. The physicsdolphin/nv-uefi-unlocker is a game-changing low-level systems tool written in Rust that acts as a UEFI pre-driver unlocker for NVIDIA GeForce GPUs across GTX 16, RTX 20, 30, and 40 series. 

It completely removes constraints on FP16, BF16, TF32, and FP8 workloads, restoring full compute performance for your local training, fine-tuning, and inference pipelines right before the OS boots.

✨ Key Features:
• Pre-OS UEFI Execution: Applies patches early in the boot sequence before the OS bootloader takes over, requiring zero kernel-level hooks.
• Non-Destructive Volatile Patching: Does not permanently flash or modify your VBIOS. Changes live in volatile memory and safely revert on a full power cycle.
• Rust-Based Safety & Rigor: Features strict read-back validation, mock testing frameworks, and robust transaction chains for hardware safety.
• Cross-Platform Boot Media: Includes streamlined deployment scripts to quickly provision self-contained UEFI bootable FAT32 USB drives on Windows and Linux.

Whether you want to dramatically speed up your local LLM workloads on an RTX 4090 or 3090, or you're a systems programmer diving into advanced UEFI programming and GPU internals in Rust, this repository is an absolute must-watch.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/physicsdolphin/nv-uefi-unlocker

Tired of the tedious, error-prone dance of creating bootable USB sticks just to test Linux? 🛑

Say goodbye to BIOS configuration headaches and risky manual partition management. Hop lets you install Linux directly from a Windows PowerShell interface without ever needing external media! 🚀

Built with .NET, Hop is a single Windows application designed to eliminate the friction of dual-booting. Whether you are testing native Linux command-line tools, checking containerization edge cases, or benchmarking file system performance on bare metal, Hop reduces setup time from hours down to a single streamlined workflow. 💻⚡

✨ Key Features:
• Intelligent Partition Management: Safely shrinks partitions and even clears unmovable files blocking the process in a single click.
• Automated Internal Emulation: Writes verified ISO files to a local FAT32 partition and registers a one-time UEFI startup entry.
• Broad Distribution Support: Works seamlessly with Ubuntu and its flavors, Fedora, Debian, Arch, and elementary OS.
• Built-In Safety: Includes comprehensive safety checks, an undo functionality to restore space, and easy cleanup of existing installations.

Stop disrupting your primary Windows workflow with complex dual-boot setups. Perfect for developers, sysadmins, and tech enthusiasts who need native Linux testing environments fast. 🛠️🐧

👉 Check out the repo and try it out today: https://github.com/Arjun-Ingole/hop
